name: Prince Hall
description: American free Black leader and Freemason (c. 1736 – 1807)
summary: Prince Hall (c. 1735/38 – December 7, 1807) was an American abolitionist and leader in the free Black community in Boston. He founded Prince Hall Freemasonry and lobbied for education rights for African-American children. He was also active in the Back-to-Africa movement.
